info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Petadoption Pets Adopteds-v3-spec
info.description: The Adopted Pets Listing API provides a comprehensive view of all pets that have been successfully adopted through the pet adoption program. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a list of adopted pets, showcasing their details and adoption status. Typical consumers include adoption agencies, pet shelters, and individuals interested in tracking adopted pets. By utilizing this API, developers can easily integrate pet adoption data into their applications, facilitating informed decision-making and enhancing user engagement.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of adopted pets.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch details about pets that have been adopted. It provides an overview of the animals that are no longer available for adoption, helping to keep the records up-to-date and provide transparency to both adopters and shelters.

requestBody.description: This request body is intended to retrieve a list of adopted pets. It may include additional filtering criteria based on user specifications.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of adopted pets.
